summary: Roo Code is a VS Code coding-agent extension; the repo also ships a standalone CLI (apps/cli, binary name `roo`) that loads the built extension bundle (src/dist/extension.js) through a VS Code API shim and drives the same agent loop from the terminal. Non-interactive use is `roo --print "<prompt>"` with `--workspace` pointing at the task directory; in print mode all tools, commands and edits are auto-approved and the process exits when the task completes. Provider/model come from `--provider` and `--model` flags (only anthropic, openai-native, gemini, openrouter, vercel-ai-gateway are accepted) and the API key from the provider's env var. The Anthropic provider constructs `new Anthropic({ baseURL: anthropicBaseUrl || undefined, apiKey })`, so with no base URL configured the SDK (0.37.0) falls back to ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, which routes every call to $PROXY_URL/v1/messages (streaming, native tool calling). openai-native is not usable because it speaks the Responses API, not chat completions.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=buildpack-deps:bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

ARG NODE_VERSION=20.19.2
ARG PNPM_VERSION=10.8.1
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git xz-utils bash \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Self-contained Node runtime under /opt/harness/node (never touches the base image's node/python).
RUN set -eux; \
    case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) a=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) a=arm64 ;; *) echo "unsupported arch"; exit 1 ;; esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/node /opt/harness/bin /out /work; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${a}.tar.xz" \
      | tar -xJ --strip-components=1 -C /opt/harness/node
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH
RUN npm install -g "pnpm@${PNPM_VERSION}"

# Harness source (monorepo). Only the CLI (apps/cli) and the extension bundle (src) are built.
COPY . /opt/harness/src
ENV HUSKY=0 CI=1
RUN cd /opt/harness/src \
 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter "roo-cline..." --filter "@roo-code/cli..." \
 && pnpm --filter @roo-code/types build \
 && pnpm --filter @roo-code/build build \
 && pnpm --filter roo-cline bundle \
 && pnpm --filter @roo-code/cli build \
 && pnpm store prune

# Thin launcher: the CLI auto-detects the extension bundle at ../../src/dist and ripgrep under apps/cli/node_modules.
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
      'export ROO_CLI_ROOT=/opt/harness/src/apps/cli' \
      'export ROO_EXTENSION_PATH=/opt/harness/src/src/dist' \
      'exec /opt/harness/node/bin/node /opt/harness/src/apps/cli/dist/index.js "$@"' \
      > /opt/harness/bin/roo \
 && chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/roo \
 && ln -sf /opt/harness/bin/roo /usr/local/bin/roo \
 && printf '%s\n' 'export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH' > /etc/profile.d/harness.sh
run_command: mkdir -p /out; roo --print --provider anthropic --model "${ROO_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-4-5}" --workspace "$PWD" "$TASK" </dev/null 2>&1 | tee /out/roo-output.txt; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; cp -r "$HOME/.vscode-mock/global-storage/tasks" /out/tasks 2>/dev/null; cp "$HOME/.roo/cli-debug.log" /out/ 2>/dev/null; exit $rc
notes: Verified locally with Docker: the overlay builds on buildpack-deps:bookworm and on the given buildpack-deps:jammy/python3.11 task image; the check command passes under `bash -lc` on both; a smoke run against a fake Anthropic-messages server created the requested file in the mounted workspace, exited 0, and left roo-output.txt plus tasks/<id>/{api_conversation_history,ui_messages,task_metadata}.json under /out. Details: (1) Model must be a key of anthropicModels in packages/types (claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-opus-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, ...); unknown IDs silently fall back to the default. The proxy replaces the name anyway. (2) The CLI has no base-URL flag; routing works because the Anthropic SDK reads ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL when the handler passes baseURL undefined. Requests go to $PROXY_URL/v1/messages with stream:true and native tools. (3) The default reasoning effort is "medium", which sends an Anthropic `thinking` budget for models that support it; pass `-r disabled` in run_command if the far-side model rejects that. (4) API errors auto-retry with exponential backoff indefinitely in print mode; add `--exit-on-error` to fail fast instead. Follow-up questions auto-select the first suggestion (stdin is /dev/null). (5) Login shells reset PATH from /etc/profile, hence the /etc/profile.d entry and the /usr/local/bin symlink in addition to ENV PATH. (6) HUSKY=0 skips git-hook install during pnpm install (no .git in the context); the .dockerignore in the repo drops tests, dist, .env and apps/* except apps/cli, which is compatible with this build. pnpm install is filtered to the extension and CLI workspaces so the webview, docs and e2e apps are not installed. (7) State persists under $HOME/.vscode-mock and $HOME/.roo inside the container; --ephemeral would delete the trajectory, so it is not used. (8) Startup may attempt a few outbound fetches (model lists for router providers, Roo Cloud, MCP marketplace); they fail silently and do not block the task.
